articles.title: Letters: Beacon Road Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting. Please keep the park bench program in the budget. Many of us on Beacon Road use it every week.

To the editor: I have lived on Beacon Road for 28 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Mildred Prentice, Lower Millrace

articles.title: Then & Now: the Mill Hill Town Hall, 1985 and 2016
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1985 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Mulberry Court from the corner of Clover Road.
Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.
Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.
